steps: Dice red bell pepper into small pieces and set aside.
In a bowl, mash cooked black beans roughly with a fork, leaving some texture.
Stir corn kernels, diced red bell pepper, ground cumin, and lime juice into the mashed black beans.
Grate cheddar finely and sprinkle half over four corn tortillas.
Spread the black bean mixture evenly over the cheese-topped tortillas, then top each with remaining cheddar.
Press a second corn tortilla firmly on top of each filled tortilla.
Heat canola oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat, about 180 °C (350 °F).
Cook each quesadilla for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and cheese is melted.
Cut into small wedges before serving. Makes 32 wedges · 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.
